summary.description: One or two sentences: what the commit changes and whether anything in it needs fixing. Specific to this commit.

findings.description: Defects this commit introduced or exposed that are still present at the branch head. Empty when there are none.

severity.description: critical = data loss, security breach, broken install or release-blocking regression. medium = incorrect behavior or a realistic production failure. low = minor, local, nice to fix.

confidence.description: sure = provable from the commit and the code at the branch head. likely = depends on behavior outside what was read. unsure = plausible, needs a person's judgment.

locations.description: Every affected path:line at the branch head for this exact issue.

line.description: Line number in the file as it is at the branch head.

why.description: One to three short sentences: what the code does now, what it should do, and the consequence.

fix_summary.description: One sentence: the smallest change that resolves it. Omit when no concrete fix applies.
